reviews.title: Pretty and fun
reviews.body: Fun to put together, very detailed. The instructions are clear and it's easy enough to do. The amount of details makes it time consuming enough to be entertaining, but never frustrating. It's lightweight but sturdy enough to pick up and turn around. It's going to be a great item for my halloween decorations this year
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on August 18, 2025
reviews.author: Janet  Bravo

reviews.title: Great fun, yet challenging.
reviews.body: This was an extremely fun project. The quality of the packaging is absolutely beautiful. Well done. The instructions are clear and easy to read. I will say this, though...the add says 4+ hours. Given that, be ready to spend much more time than you'd think, especially if you want it done well. It probably took 10 hours easily. However, that made it even more worth it.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on October 23, 2025
reviews.author: Andrea Simms

reviews.title: Lot's of fun, challenging, end result mind blown
reviews.body: Father 42 bought this for son 14 whitout big expectations, but wow! This was the coolest puzzle ever! very well made, blew my mind. We had a great time building the ship together, it can be challenging! take your time an follow the instructions! I would recommend using the thin end of utencils rather than the "tool' made of cardboard that come's with the box.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on November 14, 2025
reviews.author: Tr.lothbrok

reviews.title: Looks really cool!
reviews.body: Overall product is good. Some pieces don't fit quite right but it's not bad either. Glue is not needed, but I do recommend having some on hand to help mend any tears you may make in the cardboard and paper pieces and to help force a few pieces to work.Overall, the look is fantastic, especially from a short distance away and is fairly easy to put together. The LED lights make it look amazing in the dark!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on October 29, 2022
reviews.author: Stan

reviews.title: May take longer than expected for a perfectionist
reviews.body: Beautiful puzzle when put together . May take longer than expected to put together if you want the experience of a puzzle to last.( it didn’t happen for me) stayed up late to finish it once I got started. I think the box said it takes about 4 hours to complete well with my big fingers it took about 7.5 hours but it was worth every minute it turned out great
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on January 5, 2026
reviews.author: Troy Sepulveda

reviews.title: Really fun Christmas gift
reviews.body: Gave this to my wife as a Christmas gift. She loves puzzles and is also really into pirates so I thought that this would be perfect. Indeed, it was.She really enjoyed working on this during her Christmas break and the end result is a really cool piece that we will place onto a floating shelf in her home office.All of the pieces were there and they are of quality construction. The instructions were clear and easy to follow. We did have to use a tiny spot of super glue on two pieces at the bow of the ship but other than that, everything fit together the way it was supposed to.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on January 1, 2025
reviews.author: Scott The Wolf Tamer

reviews.title: Actually impressed!
reviews.body: So in all honesty, it was a bit of a pain at times to assemble. The directions weren't awful but they were not great either. I did expect it to be a more sturdier material so when I opened the packaging I was kinda shocked that it was mainly flimsy cardboard. With that being said, I was impressed with the fact it came together so nicely and looks incredible as it does. With the leds of or on it looks good, it has a nice size to it once completed and it does hold up. The only thing that feels like a bummer is how long will this cardboard ship last?
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 3, 2022
reviews.author: Michael Katsak

reviews.title: It breaks easy
reviews.body: If I could i would give it a zero star review. I bought this as a gift for my dad and he started to put it together. But there were parts that didn't fit where they were meant to go and he had to try and get them to fit. And then anything that bent he tried to fix it and it snapped. It is cheap and the price is a damn scam. It's like the people that made it didn't try to put it together and see how what was gonna go wrong with the materials that they used. I HATE IT!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on October 25, 2025
reviews.author: Iris

features: UNVEIL THE LEGEND OF THE FLYING DUTCHMAN: Bring the legendary ghost ship to life with our 3D Flying Dutchman Puzzle. With 360 intricately designed pieces and a length of 27 inches, this model captures the eerie essence of the ship, featuring two decks, 24 cannons, and ghostly details like tattered sails and a haunting bow. It’s a mesmerizing display piece

CHALLENGING, FUN & REWARDING: No tools or glue needed, just seamless assembly and hours of captivating fun. With clear, easy-to-follow instructions, you'll relish the process and the rewarding experience of completing this ghostly masterpiece. Set aside around 4 hours for an unforgettable building journey

PREMIUM CRAFTSMANSHIP: Expertly made with non-toxic EPS foam board and high-definition printed paper, every detail is crafted to perfection. The sturdy construction ensures your ghost ship stands strong, ready to haunt any space it inhabits

GREAT FOR RAINY DAYS & MORE: Perfect for a rainy day, a quiet evening, or a weekend project, our 3D Flying Dutchman Puzzle offers a creative escape. It’s an excellent choice for holidays, or whenever you need a break from screens and want to dive into a legendary adventure

A GREAT GIFT FOR ALL OCCASIONS: Ideal for ages 12 and up, this puzzle makes a unique gift that’s perfect for Halloween, Christmas, or any special occasion. Whether for a friend, family member, or even as a teacher's gift, it’s a thoughtful and creative choice that will be appreciated by all
